page.notes: Sub-heading "Ex I I^a." is transcribed as "Ex II^a." (the printed superscript a is hard to read). "[Sanctus]" is printed in square brackets, which are kept. "suaderes" is uncertain: the initial letter could be a long s or f, so it is marked [?]. "Ief." in the note 'n' may be "Ief.", not confirmed. A small bullet (•) after "habent." is not transcribed. Marginal "Sect. XVI." sits level with the subtitle; it is attached to the first paragraph after the heading. Digitiser's "Digitized by Google" banner is left out.
